projects.title: Heritage to Modernity
projects.description:
Union Mall revitalizes the historic 1927 Union Building, blending its heritage with modern design. 

We collaborated with Union Mall to enhance their online presence through web design, social media, and animation, aligning with their mission of exceptional service.

Webbing Together Union’s Legacy

We collaborated with Union to create a website that features a contemporary aesthetic that honors the architectural legacy of the Union Building while promoting an inviting atmosphere for exploration.
